how: A member supplies coordinates and explicitly asks others to help repair the symbol.
A repairer doubts available manpower while continuing to fill the damaged bat.
Members propose several Batman representations and sequence further characters after the batsignal.
Members report beginnings and placed lettering without establishing one shared construction history.
The batsignal proposal supplies coordinates and a linked pattern for placement.
A member answers the repair proposal with a bare assent that requests nothing further.
Members call for repair and protection, describe damage, fill the bat, and report apparent recovery.
A participant refuses unrestricted expansion and distinguishes their desired conduct from the void.
A neighbour conditions acceptance of the proposed outline on preserving its existing border.
Neighbours offer repair help and later exchange greetings and a retrospective protection report.
Posts display existing logos and announce a Batlogo at the event's end.
The final Batlogo post minimally records the work's reported end state.
Moderators and members perform a Green Arrow takeover through denial, green hints, Olicity jokes, alarm, and welcome.
Fandom lore supplies a stated reason to refuse expansion and a reason to help a fellow Leaguer.
A self-identified neighbour carries a repair request and border condition without demonstrated authority over every placer.
Attribute only proposing or beginning unless independent joining is evidenced, since the early starts have no demonstrated followers.
Count decisions about canvas organisation separately from votes closing an inherited monthly character ritual.
Isolated personal sequencing cannot establish the complete presence or absence of collective canvas decision structure.
Members correct perceived absence by locating an existing mark and accepting the correction while leaving its makers unidentified.
Shared design proposals pass through requested previews and explicit deferral without demonstrated implementation.
A recipient requests a different image host before continuing consideration of the supplied design preview.
Treat unlimited expansion as a refused proposal rather than an enacted attack or evidence of a named rival.
The same poster immediately follows displaying the placed logo with a call to protect it.
The repair proposal receives a bare assent without a further request.
The expansion proposal receives an explicit refusal grounded in the participant's stated norm of justice.
Permit cooperative neighbours to initiate warning and negotiation without assuming that their pixels caused the erosion.
Allow assistance to begin with incoming neighbour offers rather than requiring the threatened room to request outside help first.
Border talk cannot explain the initial offer of help when that offer precedes the negotiated border condition.
Restraint can precede the neighbour's border condition rather than arise from a settled agreement.
Require a decision to relinquish the spot before predicting relocation because manpower doubt here is followed by continued repair and apparent recovery.
An announcement of an existing mark does not establish known collective authorship or a continuous construction history.
Allow announcement and minimal recording to coincide in one final-image post rather than infer a separate successive transition.
Neighbour warnings and offers precede reported repair, without establishing which request caused any placement.
Preserve the inherited monthly character vote, lore, recommendations, and quotation exchange as ordinary ritual alongside canvas organisation.
Attack warnings and uncertain maker identification do not establish tracing or assigning responsibility for changed pixels.
The repairer continues working after doubting manpower, while a subsequent move is not documented.
Post-event greetings and protection recollections do not establish a decision to continue the effort or relationship.
A manual repair report does not reveal whether scripts, placement bots, or spare accounts also operated.
Named helper offers and a proposed connecting design do not establish coalition formation or membership.
An unnamed attack warning and recovery report do not document a rival-directed contest in talk.
Adjacent border negotiation and proposed flames through another logo do not establish hosted territory under a host's rule.
Playful moderator denial and an unrelated character vote do not establish containment of canvas talk.
A conditional border acceptance does not show a dispute over who may commit either room.
A final display and coordinate request do not show a dispute over cleanup or the preserved account.
The expansion dispute supplies no evidence of a quarrel carried over from before the canvas.
Lore names an intended helper relationship rather than a specific rival being attacked.
Calls and subsequent work reports do not establish that recruitment caused the reported placements.
Separate starts lack a documented path from a starter to other members' recruitment.
Maintenance and manpower doubt do not establish or rule out an ensuing turn to machine hands.
The final record and friendly greetings do not document a decision to carry the effort forward.
An initial pattern and a later deferred preview do not demonstrate that design argument was settled by an agreed template.
A repair call preceding an expansion proposal does not establish that recruitment caused the aggressive proposal.
The early expansion refusal and later border bargain lack a documented causal connection.
The refused expansion proposal is not followed by documented rival-directed contest talk.
Neighbour offers under strain do not document a resulting coalition.
Calls for help coexist with ordinary ritual but do not document a flood causing host containment.
The border condition has no documented subsequent dispute over authority to bind placers.
